implementation_notes_for_main_agent: Strictly enforce the mobile-first shell layout: Render everything inside a max-width 430px container centered on the screen, mimicking a mobile phone. Background of the main body should be pitch black.
Do NOT use standard HTML date inputs. Use Shadcn components for forms.
Implement the Boarding Pass Card using the `flight_card` layout specs. The divider must be a dashed border with pseudo-elements to create the 'cutout' ticket effect.
For the Recharts in Home, use the emerald accent colors and remove cartesian grid lines to keep it clean.
Implement dark mode first. All surfaces should be layered to establish hierarchy without relying solely on borders.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements for robust testing.
